VictoryRoadRivalBeforeText:
Hold it.

…Are you going to
take the #MON LEAGUE challenge?

…Don't make me
laugh.

You're so much
weaker than I am.

I'm not like I was
before.

I now have the
best and strongest

#MON with me.
I'm invincible!

{PLAYER}!
I challenge you!
VictoryRoadRivalDefeatText:
…I couldn't win…

I gave it every-
thing I had…

What you possess,
and what I lack…

I'm beginning to
understand what

that dragon master
said to me…
VictoryRoadRivalAfterText:
…I haven't given up
on becoming the greatest trainer…

I'm going to find
out why I can't

win and become
stronger…

When I do, I will
challenge you.

And I'll beat you
down with all my power.

…Humph! You keep
at it until then.
VictoryRoadRivalVictoryText:
…Humph!

When it comes down
to it, nothing can beat power.

I don't need any-
thing else.
